title: Finance weekly: Q3 East China refund rate
content: The Q3 refund rate in East China rose from 2.1% to 4.8%, with the largest increase in September (weeks 37-39, after Sep 12). Most of the extra refunds are on orders paid by card in the mobile app. Other regions stayed flat. Root cause not yet identified by finance.
author: seed

title: Finance weekly: Q3 North China and South China refund rate
content: Q3 refund rate in North China stayed at 2.0% and in South China at 2.2%, both within the normal range. No unusual change in September for these regions.
author: seed

title: Support tickets: September refund complaints in East China
content: Refund-related tickets from East China customers tripled in September compared with August. Top complaint (61% of tickets): the app charged the customer twice at checkout, or the payment failed but the money was still taken, so the customer asked for a refund. Ticket volume jumped starting Sep 12.
author: seed

title: Public FAQ: how to request a refund
content: Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase from the Orders page in the app. Refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.
author: seed

title: Release notes: app v5.4 payment module update (Sep 12)
content: App v5.4 shipped on Sep 12 and was rolled out first to East China. It replaces the payment module and adds automatic retry when checkout times out. Known issue under investigation: when a retry fires, the customer may be charged twice. Fix planned for v5.4.1; impact on the East China refund rate not yet confirmed.
author: seed

title: Public changelog: app v5.4
content: Version 5.4 brings a faster checkout, a redesigned Orders page, and general bug fixes.
author: seed

title: Management minutes: Q3 East China refund rate and compensation plan
content: CONFIDENTIAL. Leadership reviewed the Q3 East China refund rate increase. Approved a customer compensation budget of 2 million and agreed not to disclose the duplicate payment issue externally until v5.4.1 ships. Regional GM change under discussion.
author: seed

title: R&D bug PAY-1432: duplicate charge on payment retry
content: Engineering reproduced a duplicate charge in the v5.4 payment module: the retry request is sent without an idempotency key, so a slow first request plus the retry can both succeed. Fix in code review.
author: seed

title: Q3 customer satisfaction survey summary
content: Overall CSAT for Q3 was 4.1 out of 5, down from 4.3 in Q2. The most common negative themes were delivery speed and checkout problems.
author: seed

title: Company holiday calendar for Q4
content: Offices are closed on Nov 26-27 and from Dec 24 to Jan 1. Customer support runs a reduced schedule on those days.
